Manifest.Name: Tinkerer Chance
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description:
Turns the Tinkerer perk into a setting instead of a fixed 20% chance: pick any keep-chance from 0 to 100% and it applies immediately. Press F4 (rebindable) for a small window with the slider; both the chance and the hotkey are remembered between sessions.
Works on the game's own upgrade materials - machines, modules, toolboxes, water tanks, reactors, cages, husbandry - and also on Scavenging Tool Upgrades, which rolls its own hardcoded 20% and is patched when that mod is installed. Gun repair kits are unaffected: the game destroys those unconditionally and never rolls Tinkerer on them.
100% to test, 20% for vanilla balance, 0% to make the perk do nothing.
https://github.com/lethecus/probably-stolen-mods The source for all my mods if you wish to confirm nothing shady going on.
